title: Just a Coin
description: A Mod that adds a purple coin, wallet incoming..
body:
A Mod that simply adds a Purple Coin.
The Coin does nothing but look cool. If u EVER need Just a Coin for your Minecraft Server, because you want to set up trades and not have the resource pack solution, removing an item from the game, use Just a Coin.

-------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

FUTURE UPDATES

Wallet: An Item with one "infinitly" big slot to Store all and only your Money.

Different Coin Designs: Change the coin to match your theme

Please use the mod as you like.
